issues.reason: Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated qualifier — 'carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap' — and dropping the numeral leaves the parse indistinguishable from 'yields a vessel', widening exactly-one to at-least-one.

gaps_confirmed: a cardinal numeral on a SINGULAR count NP ('one vessel'): Cardinality is specified only as a count atom riding a group witness for a plural referred to as a unit, so a singleton has no licensed carrier
defect_summary: No carrier is licensed for a numeral on a singular count NP, so the compliant options were the nearest licensed shape — a one-member group in the Patient slot, (GroupOf sk_group_1 vessel) (Cardinality sk_group_1 1) — or, per Core patterns, leaving the quantified claim out and recording the gap; emitting the bare unquantified (Patient sk_yield_1 sk_vessel_1) is precisely what that rule forbids.
notes: The rest is right: an indefinite subject under a verbal predicate correctly mints a witness rather than a generic rule, Agent for the inanimate transitive subject, no status atom for the habitual, and the thin_day fusion emits both the head genus and the gradable modifier genus as the compound rule requires.
